name: Northern Arc Capital Ltd
title: Northern Arc Capital Ltd - 544260 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Northern Arc's Q4FY26 PAT of INR133 crore (up 251% YoY) is flattered by FLDG-driven ECL releases; management guides FY27 AUM growth 22-25% and credit cost 2.7-2.8%, with ROA target above 3%.

triggers.label: FY27 AUM growth 22-25%
triggers.quote: look at anywhere between 22% to 25%, and that's our commitment to the Street

triggers.label: Credit cost 2.7-2.8% FY27
triggers.quote: we would expect the credit cost to be in the range of 2.7 % to 2.8%, that is what is the plan projection

triggers.label: Q4 credit cost flattered by FLDG benefit
triggers.quote: the actual the credit cost without the overlay and adjusted for all this would have been closer to around 120 crores

triggers.label: Incremental CoF 8.6% vs 9.3%
triggers.quote: Our incremental cost of fund in Q4FY26 was 8.6% down from 9.3% same period last year

guidance.quote: look at anywhere between 22% to 25%, and that's our commitment to the Street
we would expect the credit cost to be in the range of 2.7 % to 2.8%
my objective is to get to 3 plus return on assets
get to mid-teens and late-teens ROE
the mix continues to improve from 59 % to targeted 65%

prior_guidance_check.quote: full-year credit cost improved to 2.8% in line with the guidance we have issued earlier

red_flags.label: Q4 PAT flattered by FLDG ECL release
red_flags.quote: the actual the credit cost without the overlay and adjusted for all this would have been closer to around 120 crores

red_flags.label: Stage-2 coverage optically lower via FLDG
red_flags.quote: optically the ECL coverage has come down for the Stage -2

red_flags.label: Management says rate cycle bottoming, CoF rising
red_flags.quote: we are seeing the interest rate bottoming out and with inflation going up, in next couple of quarters we should see the RBI also increasing rates

evasions.topic: Credit cost adjustment and FLDG write-back quantum
evasions.quote: Ashish Mehrotra: Number, but I think you need to adjust for what you took as one-time
Ashish Mehrotra: Okay, sure. We've always said that the risk -adjusted yield on the consumer finance book will hover between 15 to 16%.
